title: Hinomori Shiho — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Days before Shiho's birthday
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, that will be all for today's meeting. Thank you for your time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I used my brain so much that I'm starving!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, shall we get a treat on the way home?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: By the way, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah, yes? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your birthday is coming up soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, that's correct...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Have you remembered all of our birthdays, Mr. Shindo?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Well, I am your manager, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's also written in your documents, so I am aware of that much.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's a little early, but happy birthday. Looking forward to continuing working with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. I also look forward to continuing working with you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good for you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I really wasn't expecting you to wish me a happy birthday, Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I at least do that much.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Anyway, now that that's done, I have something to give to you all...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something?
bgm_area00001
A few hours later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, you said he gave you something? What was it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! It was... These fan letters!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Fan letters?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Apparently people who have been supporting us from a while back have been sending these to Solis Records.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So are those fan letters for you, Shiho? You've got two there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's written in them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, stuff like they're rooting for us and such. They also talked about our performances too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Performances?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Like how our music gave them courage, and really resonated in their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It feels nice to actually know that we're reaching others with our performance.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right... It's like these letters were an early birthday present, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Timing-wise, I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nothing! Ichi, Hona! Let's get Shiho to smile even bigger than she is now at her birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, we're also going to give you a grand birthday celebration too, Shih. We'll be waiting for you girls right here♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Okay, got it. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone looks really pumped about all of this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Maybe a little too much. I hope they won't be running around in circles...)
Shiho's birthday
A Cafe

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Come right in, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome to your birthday party!♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The decorations...are interesting. Everything is green...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, surprised? It's jungle-inspired☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Why jungle?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. That's because this party's theme is treasure hunting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And treasure hunting basically means...The jungle!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Treasure hunting?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Without further ado, let's commence the treasure hunting. I'll leave Shizuku, Haruka and An to give you the rundown!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So everyone has hidden a piece of treasure here. Your job is to find them, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can't reveal what sort of treasure it is, but... I'm sure you'll know when you see it. I hope you'll do your best to find them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. We all found some interesting places to hide them, so it might be a challenge for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? Okay, I better get started then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oooh... I-I'm starting to get nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Where should I start? I guess I could begin with this table here.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, there's place cards. Looks like this is my seat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? There's something underneath the plate...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is this...a letter?
